reading.body:
This entry does not represent an active data center campus. The listed business, DataPro USA Web Development, was a web design firm whose domain is now a parked for-sale page, indicating the company is inactive or defunct. The stored address in Scottsdale resolves to a different current occupant, Hole Hunter Industries, with no public evidence of server infrastructure or colocation equipment at this location.

No specifications are published for this facility. The entry appears to be a mistagged point in OpenStreetMap that conflated a small web-development business with data center infrastructure.

This campus does not belong in a study of AI infrastructure and should be removed from further analysis.
